item.title: Hunting Account Takeovers in the Wild West of MCP OAuth Servers
item.description:
Hunting Account Takeovers in the Wild West of MCP OAuth Servers
#

TL;DR: We discovered that many MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers powering AI integrations like ChatGPT and Claude have critically misconfigured OAuth implementations. Open Dynamic Client Registration (DCR) combined with missing redirect URI validation and optional PKCE enforcement creates a perfect storm for one-click account takeover attacks.

item.title: ATO via Facebook OAuth Due Unsanitized Schema Allows to Steal OAuth Token
item.description:
Deep Dive into an OAuth Exploit: A 0-Day Case Study
#

Hello Everyone,

In our continuous hunt for novel attack vectors and security challenges, mainteemoforfun and I embarked on an in-depth exploration of mobile authentication mechanisms. Our efforts culminated in the discovery of a striking 0-day vulnerability back in 2023 that has since been patched.

This vulnerability enabled us to potentially hijack user sessions on websites utilizing Facebook’s “Login With Facebook” feature. By manipulating the redirect_uri parameter in the OAuth flow, an attacker could redirect authentication tokens to a host under their control.
